name: envio_kafka
description: Lê a view de payload (nome injetado via param_view_payload), serializa o struct 'payload' para JSON, monta headers REGISTRO/ENVIO e publica no Kafka. Tópico vem via param_topico (substituído no path do output).

transformations.name: headers
transformations.expression: array(struct(cast('type' as string) as key, cast('REGISTRO' as binary) as value), struct(cast('kind' as string) as key, cast('ENVIO' as binary) as value))
